title: Growth charts: are you on track?
character: Full-body paper cut-out collage illustration of a friendly young guy with neat wavy brown hair, warm smiling expression, wearing a warm golden-yellow t-shirt, dark charcoal navy trousers, and white sneakers, slight paper texture and soft drop shadow, standing frontally on a clean plain white background

scenes.vo: Have you ever wondered if you're growing fast enough?

figures.pose: Young guy with wavy brown hair looking up curiously at a tall measuring line, hands relaxed at sides, golden-yellow tee and charcoal pants

scenes.vo: Doctors compare your height against official pediatric growth charts.
scenes.photo: Clean 3D medical render of a colorful pediatric growth chart clipboard with smooth percentile curves, a stethoscope resting beside it, soft studio lighting, vertical framing

scenes.vo: At fourteen, the average American boy stands five-four.

figures.pose: Young teen boy with neat wavy brown hair standing proudly upright, smiling, golden-yellow tee and dark charcoal pants
figures.label: Boy, 14

icons.prompt: Flat cut-out icon of the United States flag in vibrant red and blue
icons.label: US Average

scenes.vo: While the average fourteen-year-old girl is about five-three.

figures.pose: Teen boy with neat wavy brown hair standing straight in a golden-yellow tee
figures.label: Boy, 14

figures.pose: Teen girl with brown ponytail smiling kindly, wearing a coral pink tee and charcoal trousers
figures.label: Girl, 14

scenes.vo: Growth charts use percentiles to see how you rank.
scenes.photo: Realistic top-down macro photograph of a pediatric growth curve graph with clean percentile lines 5th, 50th, 95th printed on textured medical paper, shallow depth of field, vertical

scenes.vo: Fiftieth percentile means half are taller, half are shorter.

figures.pose: Slightly shorter boy in a light blue tee looking up smiling
figures.label: 25th

figures.pose: Young guy with wavy brown hair in golden-yellow tee waving cheerfully
figures.label: 50th

figures.pose: Taller teen boy in a sage green tee standing straight
figures.label: 75th

scenes.vo: What matters most is following your own steady curve.

figures.pose: Young guy with wavy brown hair at age twelve smiling, golden-yellow tee
figures.label: Age 12

figures.pose: Same young guy at age fourteen standing confident, golden-yellow tee
figures.label: Age 14

figures.pose: Same young guy at age sixteen looking tall and happy, golden-yellow tee
figures.label: Age 16

icons.prompt: Flat cut-out icon of a rising green upward trend line graph on a rounded white card
icons.label: Steady Curve

scenes.vo: A sudden drop across lines means check with a doctor.

figures.pose: Young guy with wavy brown hair looking puzzled and concerned, shoulders slightly slouched, golden-yellow tee
figures.label: Drop

icons.prompt: Flat cut-out icon of a red medical cross on a white circle
icons.label: Check In

scenes.vo: So are you on track for your adult height?

figures.pose: Young guy standing frontally, pointing friendly toward the viewer with an inviting warm smile, golden-yellow tee
figures.label: Your Path

icons.prompt: Flat cut-out icon of a bright yellow measuring tape rolled in a circle
icons.label: Track Now

scenes.vo: And there's way more inside our app. Predict your height in TallPlan.

figures.pose: Young guy smiling brightly, holding up a smartphone showing a colorful clean growth graph, golden-yellow tee and dark charcoal pants

icons.prompt: Flat cut-out icon of a blue smartphone with a rising colorful chart on its screen
icons.label: TallPlan
